title: Five or six years with Tom Albert; other bands he worked with
summary: Albert treated him like a son; he freelanced with Kid Rena, Chris Kelly, Buddy Petit, Jack Carey and others.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: What other bands did you sort of play around with like your son when Tom didn't have a joke? Do you remember any other bands that hired you?

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I worked with Randy a long time, often and long. Mm-hmm. I worked with Chris Kelly. I worked with Buddy Petit. I worked with Jack Carey. I worked with Leslie Mayne. I worked with a fella called Big, One-Eyed Big, bass player. Mm-hmm. I worked with him. Oh, I worked with several bands around there, different places they'd go play in there. They'd sit on me there and have nothing but tones. I was in Idol, I stayed busy all the time.
